content: Root cause: The bug was caused by the introduction of new consolidated code that failed to properly initialize the scheduling time (t), the lifetime (t2), and the birthday of the surface molecules, setting them to zero instead of allowing for non-zero values when a release pattern was used. This oversight affected functionality when dealing with molecule placements at specified times and lifetimes.

Code statements:
```c
struct surface_molecule *new_sm = place_single_molecule(
          world, w, n_tile, sm[p_index], flags, orientation[p_index], 0, 0, 0);
```
```c
struct surface_molecule *new_sm = place_single_molecule(
                    world, walls[j], idx[j], sm, flags, orientation, 0, 0, 0);
```
```c
struct surface_molecule *new_sm = place_single_molecule(
                       world, walls[slot_num], idx[slot_num], sm, flags,
                       orientation);
```

```

```
